LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 14.1.1 PRONUNCIATION AND INTONATION

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.1: Listening and Speaking 14.1.1 Pronunciation and Intonation
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 14.1.1 Pronunciation and Intonation, part of Strand 14 in Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why should we use the right intonation when speaking? 2. What are some of the words with silent letters?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. search online and offline for words with the following silent consonant letters /r//h//k//g//p//t/and /b/ and practise the pronunciation of the given words,

2. listen from the online dictionaries and tutorials for the correct articulation of the specified sounds,

3. listen to the teacher or a recording of some sentences on sports and indicate whether a falling or rising intonation has been used,

4. use correct intonation

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. search online and offline for words with the following silent consonant letters /r//h//k//g//p//t/and /b/ and practise the pronunciation of the given words,
2. listen from the online dictionaries and tutorials for the correct articulation of the specified sounds,
3. listen to the teacher or a recording of some sentences on sports and indicate whether a falling or rising intonation has been used,
4. use correct intonation

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 14.1.1 Pronunciation and Intonation together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-efficacy: It is fostered as the learner identifies what they find difficult as they endeavour to use correct intonation when

reading declarative and exclamatory sentences, and addressing the issue.

• Digital literacy: It is enhanced as the learner interacts with recording of words on digital devices.

Values:
Social justice: It is promoted as learner practises reading words with silent letters in pairs and giving constructive feedback

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Effective communication: It is enriched as the learner learns the correct pronunciation.

Links to other Learning Areas:
The learner is able to relate correct pronunciation of words and intonation in sentences in all subjects.
